title: Design System: Rocket by Dutch-Bangla Bank

headline.purpose: Centered section titles with one violet word.

body.purpose: Paragraphs at 62ch max; Bangla uses 1.0625rem and 1.75 line height.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase caption, Latin only; no tracking in Bangla.

motion.name: chip-float
motion.purpose: Hero chips; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: lenis
motion.purpose: Global smooth scroll; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Violet gradient pill; the single main action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 30px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; background: linear-gradient(100deg, #6c0ca7, #550086); box-shadow: 0 14px 26px -12px rgba(85,0,134,0.6); transition: transform .2s, background .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(100deg, #7a14b8, #46007a); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6a03af; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: White outline pill for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 30px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f0a2e; background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid #d9c9f2; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #6a03af; color: #6a03af; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6a03af; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pill Button
components.description: Compact violet outline pill that fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 26px; border: 2px solid #6a03af; border-radius: 999px; color: #6a03af; font-weight: 700; font-size: .95rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-pill:hover { background: #6a03af; color: #fff; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6a03af; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Benefit Card
components.description: 28px lavender card with a solid violet icon.
components.html:
Secure Money Transfer

Needs your phone, PIN and check digit together.
components.css: .ds-benefit { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; min-height: 221px; padding: 32px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7); border-radius: 28px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f7f6fe, #f1ecfb); box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -26px rgba(106,3,175,.35); text-align: center; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-benefit h3 { margin: 16px 0 0; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f0a2e; } .ds-benefit p { margin: 8px 0 0; max-width: 17rem; font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #625e76; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Pastel 26px card with tinted icon disc and white arrow disc; one pastel per service.
components.css: .ds-service { position: relative; display: block; height: 206px; width: 220px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 26px; background: #fde7e3; color: #0f0a2e; text-decoration: none; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 16px 30px -22px rgba(43,10,82,.35); transition: transform .3s; } .ds-service:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-service strong { display: block; margin-top: 16px; font-size: 1.05rem; } .ds-disc { display: block; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f27766; } .ds-arrow { position: absolute; right: 20px; bottom: 20px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(43,10,82,.4); } .ds-service:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6a03af; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Eyebrow with Rule
components.description: Tracked caption with a short violet rule, above centered section titles.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin: 0; font: 700 .72rem Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .24em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2b2750; } .ds-eyebrow span { width: 24px; height: 2px; background: #6a03af; } .ds-title { margin: 12px 0 0; text-align: center; font: 800 2.4rem/1.15 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.026em; color: #0f0a2e; } .ds-title em { font-style: normal; color: #6a03af; }

components.name: Hero Chip
components.description: Translucent white rounded square with violet icon, gently floating.
components.html: Send Money
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; width: 110px; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 26%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8); background: rgba(255,255,255,.85); color: #0f0a2e; font: 600 .8rem Manrope, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 22px 40px -22px rgba(106,3,175,.45); animation: ds-float 6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-float { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-8px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chip { animation: none; } } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #6a03af; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
A light lavender page wash with violet doing all the talking: ink-dark headlines whose second line turns violet, violet icons and links, and one gradient pill as the single action. Soft violet-tinted shadows and generously rounded frames keep it friendly for first-time, mixed-literacy users; a deep-violet footer closes the page. The system was rebuilt to match a user-supplied mockup, and the shipped code is the source for every value here.

The brand is Bangladeshi and says so quietly: a Shaheed Minar and a tree line sit as faded decorative SVG behind the hero, and the official wordmark stays in its own brand purple (about #8A288F, baked into the logo raster, not a token). Bangla is the first language; every type rule has a Bangla exception.
keyCharacteristics: Lavender wash fields over a near-white page; violet is the only accent.
Pill buttons, 22-32px rounded image frames and bands, 26-28px cards.
Pastels belong to the five service cards; gold belongs to the awards strip.
Shadows are soft, violet-tinted and offset downward, never hard.
Hero scales in vw so the composition keeps the mockup's proportions.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: The CTA gradient is the only gradient-filled control; secondary actions are the white outline pill.

rules.name: The Pastel Fence Rule
rules.body: Pastels appear only on service cards and their discs; gold only on the award trophy.

rules.name: The Own Purple Rule
rules.body: The wordmark keeps its brand purple; never recolor it to the UI violet.

rules.name: The Bangla Exception Rule
rules.body: In Bangla: letter-spacing 0, no uppercase, heading weight capped at 700, line height 1.3 for headings, extra word spacing.

rules.name: The Soft Violet Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are large-blur, negative-spread and violet or violet-ink tinted; no hard offset, no black.

dos: Do use violet (#6A03AF) for emphasis words, icons and links, and ink (#0F0A2E) for the rest of the headline.
Do keep primary action as the gradient pill at 52px minimum height.
Do put a short violet rule before the eyebrow only where the title is a centered section title (Why, Products, Awards).
Do round image frames and bands at 22-32px and cards at 26-28px.
Do cap Bangla heading weight at 700 and remove tracking.
Do disable float, smooth scroll and reveal motion under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use pastel grounds outside the five service cards, or gold outside the awards strip.
Don't use hard offset or black shadows.
Don't letter-space or uppercase Bangla text.
Don't stack more than one gradient button in a view.
